newsitem.title: USA: Eurogas hires Oppenheimer as adviser.
newsitem.headline: Eurogas hires Oppenheimer as adviser.

text.p: Eurogas Inc on Tuesday said it hired Oppenheimer & Co Inc to serve as its financial adviser and investment banker.

The company said Oppenheimer would review Eurogas strategic plan; assist it in obtaining a listing on the Nasdaq national market; advise and assist it in negotiating possible joint ventures; and provide other investment banking services.
